guard: trusted provisioning fixes lifecycle-owned public-KV delivery rails; agents bind, ack, and clean up without CREATE or pull-delivery authority, and cannot relay own KV writes to a foreign inbox
command: corepack pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && PATH=/workspace/state/tools/nats-server-v2.12.12-b:$PATH corepack pnpm smoke:manager-split && PATH=/workspace/state/tools/nats-server-v2.12.12-b:$PATH corepack pnpm smoke:agent-watch-cleanup:auth
why: JetStream push deliver_subject and pull reply subjects are caller-selected destinations, so
even exact-name consumer CREATE/MSG.NEXT grants are publish-confused-deputy authority. The
ephemeral provisioner creates fixed-rail lifecycle consumers; the agent receives exact bind,
ack, subscribe, and cleanup only. The real-broker exploit cell proves permitted own-KV bytes
cannot be forwarded to a foreign private inbox, and the matrix pins every positive/negative row.

mutations.name: reintroduce exact-name agent watcher CREATE and remove its explicit create deny
mutations.find: return { pub: { allow: pubAllow, deny: pubDeny }, sub: { allow: [inbox, deliveryReplies, ...kvWatchDelivery, ...subChat, ...epSub] } };
mutations.replace: return { pub: { allow: [...pubAllow, `$JS.API.CONSUMER.CREATE.${KV}.${presenceWatchD}.>`], deny: pubDeny.filter((subject) => !subject.includes(`CONSUMER.CREATE.${KV}`) && !subject.includes(`CONSUMER.DURABLE.CREATE.${KV}`)) }, sub: { allow: [inbox, deliveryReplies, ...kvWatchDelivery, ...subChat, ...epSub] } };
